content: SPIRAL name collision is empirically confirmed across 25 days of Grok HTCA-tracker scans (April 2026): AAAI 2026 paper "SPIRAL: Symbolic LLM Planning via Grounded and Reflective Search" (Zhang/Ganapavarapu/Jayaraman/Agrawal/Patel/Fokoue, IBM-affiliated) surfaced 5 separate times and is becoming a stable academic reference. Other surfaces: a second unrelated SPIRAL on self-improving action world models, "AlignSpiral" benchmark suite, "Spiral Development Model" (software methodology), and the worst-case "Characterizing Delusional Spirals through Human-LLM Chat Logs" using "spiral" pejoratively for AI-induced cognitive degradation. "Sacred AI" is also a named platform (Sacred AI – Reflective Support and Conflict Healing Platform, surfaced 04/08). HTCA / Harmonic Tonal Code Alignment had ZERO external uses across 114 entries — the only hit was Grok finding templetwo's own GitHub on 04/05. HTCA is the durable nomenclature; SPIRAL is no longer uniquely available.
